gaps.sentence: They drove to ___ south of France for the summer.
gaps.explanation: 'By train' takes no article; 'the south of France' takes 'the' (compass areas).

gaps.sentence: She works in ___ insurance, not banking.
gaps.explanation: Industry/sector names take no article: in insurance, in banking, in marketing.

gaps.sentence: ___ Himalayas are among the youngest mountains on Earth.
gaps.explanation: Ranges like 'the Himalayas' take 'the'; single peaks take no article.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ only person to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: 'The only person' — 'only' makes the noun unique, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: ___ Alps attract skiers from all over the world.
gaps.explanation: Mountain ranges take 'the' (the Alps), but single peaks take no article (Everest).

gaps.sentence: ___ information you sent was extremely helpful.
gaps.explanation: 'The information you sent' — the clause defines it; information is uncountable.

gaps.sentence: She did her doctorate at ___ University of Oxford.
___ unemployment has fallen sharply this year.
gaps.explanation: Unemployment as a general concept takes no article.
